affected_module: main-owned V0 program registry / active branch passport frontier after exact P7.3 runtime merge
canonical_owner: main-owned config/control/project-program-registry.v1.json plus the registered V0 closure passport
public_or_internal_contracts: Feature/control PR Project Control must read project state from origin/main, never self-authorize from candidate registry.
Runtime merge may temporarily make current main RED until main-owned frontier pointers are advanced.
A control-plane repair may update main-owned frontier state, after which exact post-merge Project Control must be NON_RED before next runtime substep.
expected_shipped_behavior: After the P7.3 closure control commit is merged, origin/main registers control/v0-p7-3-closure-r1 as V0 frontier. Its merge-base with canonical main is the P7.3 runtime merge and therefore the already-reviewed P7.3 files are no longer reported as unconsumed dependency drift. P7.4 remains blocked until post-merge Project Control proves NON_RED.
root_cause_hypothesis: Not a runtime or closure-data defect. The accepted harness regression intentionally resolves main-owned state through origin/main. Before the closure repair is merged, origin/main still registers the P7.2 closure passport, whose merge-base predates the newly merged P7.3 runtime files. Therefore Project Control correctly reports those files as V0 CRITICAL_DEPENDENCY_DRIFT. A candidate PR cannot make this particular finding disappear by editing its local registry because doing so would violate main-owned-state authority.
canonical_fix_location: Merge the already-bounded control-only P7.3 closure state into main via PR, then perform an exact post-merge Project Control audit against the new origin/main. Do not change runtime, auditor dependency rules, or load_main_owned semantics.
why_not_symptom_patch: Changing tests to read the candidate registry, suppressing V0 critical watched paths, setting V0 blocks_global_progress=false, or rebasing the frozen runtime would weaken critical dependency rules or invalidate exact Reviewer/Verifier freshness. None are permitted.
